verdict.rationale: Jina Reader offers a single hosted proxy option (`x-proxy: auto`) that rotates residential/datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges, but there is no evidence of an automatic retry mechanism chaining through multiple distinct proxy providers/configs on failure. missing for 10: documented retry/fallback logic across a chain of different proxies, evidence of automatic re-attempt after a block, independent confirmation of anti-bot bypass success.
